title: 实验室行为守则
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/009_实验室行为守则.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/009_实验室行为守则/src.py

points.K1: 尊重实验室，从自己的行为做起
points.K3: 课前预习：看演示不能代替读讲义
points.K4: 按书面规程做，只做培训过的工作
points.K5: 拿不准就问，不擅改方案
points.K6: 守则堵住的是暴露途径
points.K7: 不吃、不喝、不吸烟、不化妆
points.K8: 实验冰箱和微波炉不碰食品
points.K11: 别人的样品先问再动，公用器具用完归位
points.K13: 夜间节假日实验先报备，不疲劳作业
points.K14: 无人值守实验：经同意，挂牌留联系方式
points.K15: 离开前检查水电气门窗

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验室门口一块空白守则牌旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a blank lab rules board at the lab entrance and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲实验室行为守则。

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 三个图标：书本、禁止饮食、两个小人
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: an open book, a no food or drink sign, and two person pictograms side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 怎么学、什么不能做、什么不能一个人做。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 深夜，阿杰独自在实验室，加热装置在运行，他一边啃面包一边看手机
shots.prompt_en: Late at night, the young male student is alone in the lab; a heating setup is running while he eats bread and looks at his phone.
shots.narration: 深夜，阿杰一个人赶实验。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰困得打哈欠，顺手拿起旁边一瓶没标签的瓶子要倒掉
shots.prompt_en: The young male student yawns sleepily and picks up someone else's unlabeled bottle to pour it out.
shots.narration: 边吃边玩手机，还想倒掉别人的瓶子。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 小研推门进来，惊讶地举手制止
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student opens the door, surprised, and raises a hand to stop him.
shots.narration: 小研正好回来，连忙叫停。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 欣欣对镜头竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot raises one finger at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一晚，他犯了好几条守则。

shots.section_title: 尊重实验室，从自己的行为做起
shots.scene: 实验室里大家各自专心工作，彼此留出空间
shots.prompt_en: Lab members work carefully at their own benches, giving each other space.
shots.narration: 尊重实验室，也尊重身边的同伴。
overlay: 尊重实验室，从自己的行为做起

shots.section_title: 尊重实验室，从自己的行为做起
shots.scene: 一个人的行为图标连到一群人的盾牌
shots.prompt_en: One person pictogram connected by lines to a shield protecting a whole group. No people.
shots.narration: 每个人的行为，决定大家是否安全。

shots.section_title: 尊重实验室，从自己的行为做起
shots.scene: 小研把用完的台面擦干净，留给下一位
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wipes her bench clean after use, ready for the next person.
shots.narration: 体谅前一个人，照顾下一个人。

shots.section_title: 尊重实验室，从自己的行为做起
shots.scene: 墙上空白规则牌，阿杰边看边点头，眼睛扫视周围
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reads a blank rules board, nodding, then looks around for hazards.
shots.narration: 懂规则、守规则，也要会发现隐患。

shots.section_title: 听从实验室负责人
shots.scene: 老周在实验课开始时向学生讲解设备和防护
shots.prompt_en: At the start of a lab class, the older man explains equipment and protection to the students.
shots.narration: 实验课上，负责人或老师始终在场。

shots.section_title: 听从实验室负责人
shots.scene: 老周指着设备，旁边护目镜、手套图标
shots.prompt_en: The older man points at an instrument, with goggles and glove icons beside it.
shots.narration: 开工前，他会讲清技术、设备和防护。

shots.section_title: 听从实验室负责人
shots.scene: 阿杰举手向老周提问
shots.prompt_en: The young male student raises his hand to ask the older man a question.
shots.narration: 有问题，先找他。

shots.section_title: 听从实验室负责人
shots.scene: 老周抬手示意停止，学生们立刻放下手中工作
shots.prompt_en: The older man raises his hand to signal stop, and the students immediately put down their work.
shots.narration: 他的安全指令，必须照办。

shots.section_title: 课前预习：看演示不能代替读讲义
shots.scene: 阿杰在宿舍台灯下读空白实验讲义
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reads a blank lab manual under a desk lamp in his dorm.
shots.narration: 实验课前，先读讲义预习。
overlay: 课前预习：看演示不能代替读讲义

shots.section_title: 课前预习：看演示不能代替读讲义
shots.scene: 阿杰空着手站在实验台前发愣的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A pictogram of a student standing blankly at a bench with no preparation, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别指望到了现场才有人告诉你。

shots.section_title: 课前预习：看演示不能代替读讲义
shots.scene: 电脑上播放演示视频，旁边讲义
shots.prompt_en: A computer playing a blank demonstration video next to an open lab manual. No people.
shots.narration: 看演示视频只是预习，代替不了讲义。

shots.section_title: 课前预习：看演示不能代替读讲义
shots.scene: 原理图标和操作手势图标并排，各打一个勾
shots.prompt_en: A principle diagram icon and a hands-on technique icon side by side, each with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 原理和操作，两样都要弄明白。

shots.section_title: 按书面规程做，只做培训过的工作
shots.scene: 小研对照打开的空白规程，一步步操作
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student follows an open blank procedure sheet, doing the steps one by one.
shots.narration: 严格按书面规程，一步一步做。
overlay: 按书面规程做，只做培训过的工作

shots.section_title: 按书面规程做，只做培训过的工作
shots.scene: 规程上跳过一步的箭头被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A procedure flow with an arrow skipping a step, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不跳步，不凭感觉改步骤。

shots.section_title: 按书面规程做，只做培训过的工作
shots.scene: 阿杰面前一台没培训过的仪器，他停手摇头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stops in front of an instrument he was not trained on and shakes his head.
shots.narration: 只做自己受过培训的工作。

shots.section_title: 按书面规程做，只做培训过的工作
shots.scene: 别人递来一项陌生任务，阿杰先去找老周
shots.prompt_en: Someone hands the young male student an unfamiliar task; he goes to the older man first.
shots.narration: 别人的活，没学过别乱接手。

shots.section_title: 拿不准就问，不擅改方案
shots.scene: 阿杰想在一台仪器旁再放一台加热板，犹豫
shots.prompt_en: The young male student wants to place a hot plate right next to another instrument and hesitates.
shots.narration: 仪器旁边再加一台加热板？
overlay: 拿不准就问，不擅改方案

shots.section_title: 拿不准就问，不擅改方案
shots.scene: 阿杰去问小研和老周
shots.prompt_en: The young male student goes to ask the female graduate student and the older man.
shots.narration: 拿不准，先问导师或负责人。

shots.section_title: 拿不准就问，不擅改方案
shots.scene: 自己乱试和磨蹭两个图标都被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two pictograms crossed out: someone trying things randomly, and someone just working slowly. No people.
shots.narration: 不自己乱试，也不是慢慢做就行。

shots.section_title: 拿不准就问，不擅改方案
shots.scene: 修改过的方案被老周审核签字
shots.prompt_en: A revised experiment plan is reviewed and signed by the older man.
shots.narration: 要改实验方案，先经老师同意。

shots.section_title: 守则堵住的是暴露途径
shots.scene: 人体轮廓上四条箭头：口、鼻、皮肤、针刺
shots.prompt_en: A human outline with four arrows pointing at the mouth, the nose, the skin, and a needle at the hand. No people.
shots.narration: 有害物进入人体，主要有四条路。
overlay: 守则堵住的是暴露途径

shots.section_title: 守则堵住的是暴露途径
shots.scene: 四条箭头被一块块挡板挡住
shots.prompt_en: The four arrows are blocked one by one by small barrier boards. No people.
shots.narration: 行为守则，就是把这些路堵上。

shots.section_title: 守则堵住的是暴露途径
shots.scene: 受污染的手指到嘴边的箭头
shots.prompt_en: An arrow tracing contamination from a lab bench to a hand and then to a mouth. No people.
shots.narration: 手上台面的污染，会跟着进嘴。

shots.section_title: 不吃、不喝、不吸烟、不化妆
shots.scene: 禁止饮食、禁止吸烟标志贴在实验室门上
shots.prompt_en: A no eating or drinking sign and a no smoking sign on the lab door. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室里不吃不喝，严禁吸烟。
overlay: 不吃、不喝、不吸烟、不化妆

shots.section_title: 不吃、不喝、不吸烟、不化妆
shots.scene: 口香糖、咬笔头、涂口红图标都被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of chewing gum, biting a pen and applying lipstick, each crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 嚼口香糖、咬笔头、化妆，也不行。

shots.section_title: 不吃、不喝、不吸烟、不化妆
shots.scene: 实验室门外的置物柜，水杯、零食、书包放进柜里
shots.prompt_en: Outside the lab door, a water bottle, snacks and a backpack are placed into a locker.
shots.narration: 水杯零食书包，放在门外。

shots.section_title: 不吃、不喝、不吸烟、不化妆
shots.scene: 阿杰在休息区洗手后吃东西
shots.prompt_en: The young male student washes his hands and then eats in a break room outside the lab.
shots.narration: 吃喝去休息区，先洗手。

shots.section_title: 不吃、不喝、不吸烟、不化妆
shots.scene: 实验室里搭的折叠床被打叉，通道畅通
shots.prompt_en: A folding bed set up in the lab crossed out with a red X; the aisle next to it is clear. No people.
shots.narration: 不在实验室休息过夜，通道保持畅通。

shots.section_title: 实验冰箱和微波炉不碰食品
shots.scene: 试剂冰箱里放着饭盒和饮料的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A reagent refrigerator with a lunch box and a drink inside, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 试剂冰箱、培养箱，不放食物饮料。
overlay: 实验冰箱和微波炉不碰食品

shots.section_title: 实验冰箱和微波炉不碰食品
shots.scene: 实验室微波炉热饭的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A lab microwave with a lunch box inside, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室的微波炉，不热饭。

shots.section_title: 实验冰箱和微波炉不碰食品
shots.scene: 实验冰箱门上贴着禁止存放食品标志
shots.prompt_en: A lab refrigerator door with a no food storage sign. No people.
shots.narration: 实验用的冰箱，只放实验材料。

shots.section_title: 不用手碰，不闻不尝
shots.scene: 用手直接捏产物、凑近闻、伸舌头的三个图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Three crossed-out pictograms: touching a product with bare fingers, sniffing a flask, tasting. No people.
shots.narration: 产物不用手碰，不闻不尝。

shots.section_title: 不用手碰，不闻不尝
shots.scene: 小研戴手套用刮刀和镊子取样
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wearing gloves takes a sample with a spatula and tweezers.
shots.narration: 取样用刮刀、镊子。

shots.section_title: 专心操作，不嬉闹
shots.scene: 阿杰专心看着装置，手机放在柜子里
shots.prompt_en: The young male student focuses on his apparatus while his phone stays in a cabinet.
shots.narration: 专心操作，做实验时不玩手机。

shots.section_title: 专心操作，不嬉闹
shots.scene: 实验室里奔跑、打闹、恶作剧的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Pictograms of running, play fighting and pranks in a lab, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不奔跑、不打闹、不搞恶作剧。

shots.section_title: 专心操作，不嬉闹
shots.scene: 小研抬头看看周围，指出地上的一摊水
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student looks around and points out a puddle of water on the floor.
shots.narration: 留意周围，发现隐患马上说。

shots.section_title: 专心操作，不嬉闹
shots.scene: 数据本上如实记录，旁边对勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank lab notebook with honest entries and a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 守规范，数据如实记录。

shots.section_title: 别人的样品先问再动，公用器具用完归位
shots.scene: 阿杰熬了一周备好的一排样品瓶放在台上，他去补觉
shots.prompt_en: A row of sample bottles the young male student prepared over a week sits on the bench while he goes to take a nap.
shots.narration: 阿杰备好一周的样品，去补了个觉。
overlay: 别人的样品先问再动，公用器具用完归位

shots.section_title: 别人的样品先问再动，公用器具用完归位
shots.scene: 回来发现瓶子全被洗干净摆在晾架上，他抱头
shots.prompt_en: He returns to find all the bottles washed clean on a drying rack, and holds his head in dismay.
shots.narration: 有人不认识，把它们全洗了。

shots.section_title: 别人的样品先问再动，公用器具用完归位
shots.scene: 样品瓶贴上空白标签，图标：名字、日期
shots.prompt_en: Sample bottles get blank labels with icons for a name and a date. No people.
shots.narration: 自己的样品，贴好名字和日期。

shots.section_title: 别人的样品先问再动，公用器具用完归位
shots.scene: 小研拿起一个陌生瓶子，先去问人
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student picks up an unfamiliar bottle and goes to ask others before touching it further.
shots.narration: 不认识的瓶子，先问清楚再动。

shots.section_title: 别人的样品先问再动，公用器具用完归位
shots.scene: 公用移液器放回架上，登记本上签名
shots.prompt_en: A shared pipette is returned to its rack and the user signs a blank logbook.
shots.narration: 公用器具，用了登记，用完归位。

shots.section_title: 不私自改装仪器设备
shots.scene: 阿杰拿着螺丝刀要拆仪器外壳，旁边插线板串联
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a screwdriver to open an instrument casing, next to daisy-chained power strips.
shots.narration: 嫌仪器不好用，自己动手改？

shots.section_title: 不私自改装仪器设备
shots.scene: 拆外壳、拆防护罩、短接联锁的图标都被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Pictograms of removing a casing, removing a guard and bypassing an interlock, each crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不拆外壳防护罩，不短接安全联锁。

shots.section_title: 不私自改装仪器设备
shots.scene: 老李在老周批准后检修仪器
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer repairs the instrument after the older man approves the request.
shots.narration: 改装维修，报负责人，由专业人员做。

shots.section_title: 危险实验不独自做
shots.scene: 一个人在空荡的实验室做危险实验的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A pictogram of one person doing a hazardous experiment alone in an empty lab, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 危险实验，不能一个人做。

shots.section_title: 危险实验不独自做
shots.scene: 小研和阿杰一起操作，互相照应
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student work together, watching out for each other.
shots.narration: 身边有人，出事能互相帮忙。

shots.section_title: 危险实验不独自做
shots.scene: 阿杰滑倒，小研立刻扶起并拿起电话
shots.prompt_en: The young male student slips; the female graduate student immediately helps him and picks up the phone.
shots.narration: 有人照应，也有人能及时报警。

shots.section_title: 危险实验不独自做
shots.scene: 两个小人图标，旁边登记本
shots.prompt_en: Two person pictograms next to a blank whereabouts logbook. No people.
shots.narration: 高风险实验，按规定至少两人在场。

shots.section_title: 危险实验不独自做
shots.scene: 手机上给同伴发去空白消息，地图图标
shots.prompt_en: A phone sends a blank message to a colleague with a location icon. No people.
shots.narration: 至少让人知道你在哪、在做什么。

shots.section_title: 夜间节假日实验先报备，不疲劳作业
shots.scene: 日历上夜晚和节假日被标红
shots.prompt_en: A calendar with nights and holidays highlighted in red. No people.
shots.narration: 夜间节假日，人少，风险更高。
overlay: 夜间节假日实验先报备，不疲劳作业

shots.section_title: 夜间节假日实验先报备，不疲劳作业
shots.scene: 阿杰在手机上填写空白报备表，老周点头同意
shots.prompt_en: The young male student fills in a blank request on his phone; the older man nods approval.
shots.narration: 先向负责人报备，经同意再做。

shots.section_title: 夜间节假日实验先报备，不疲劳作业
shots.scene: 阿杰打哈欠，旁边疲劳图标
shots.prompt_en: The young male student yawns heavily, with a tired battery icon beside him.
shots.narration: 累了就停，不疲劳做实验。

shots.section_title: 夜间节假日实验先报备，不疲劳作业
shots.scene: 阿杰关好设备回宿舍休息
shots.prompt_en: The young male student shuts down his setup safely and heads back to rest.
shots.narration: 睡足了，明天再接着做。

shots.section_title: 无人值守实验：经同意，挂牌留联系方式
shots.scene: 加热装置旁无人，人离开的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A heating setup running with nobody around, with a red X over a person walking away. No people.
shots.narration: 加热、反应进行中，人不能走开。
overlay: 无人值守实验：经同意，挂牌留联系方式

shots.section_title: 无人值守实验：经同意，挂牌留联系方式
shots.scene: 培养箱需要过夜运行，老周批准
shots.prompt_en: An incubator needs to run overnight; the older man approves it.
shots.narration: 确需过夜运行，要经负责人同意。

shots.section_title: 无人值守实验：经同意，挂牌留联系方式
shots.scene: 【实拍】过夜运行设备上挂着空白值守牌，图标：在做什么、到几点、联系电话（无品牌）
shots.prompt_en: A blank overnight-run tag hangs on an incubator, with icons for task, end time and phone. No people.
shots.narration: 挂牌写明在做什么、到几点、怎么联系。

shots.section_title: 无人值守实验：经同意，挂牌留联系方式
shots.scene: 其他设备指示灯熄灭，插头拔下
shots.prompt_en: Other instruments have their power lights off and plugs pulled. No people.
shots.narration: 其他设备，离开前关闭断电。

shots.section_title: 离开前检查水电气门窗
shots.scene: 阿杰做完实验，关水龙头
shots.prompt_en: After finishing, the young male student turns off the water tap.
shots.narration: 做完了，关水、断电。
overlay: 离开前检查水电气门窗

shots.section_title: 离开前检查水电气门窗
shots.scene: 【实拍】离开前手部依次指向并确认水龙头、电源开关、气瓶阀、窗户（无品牌，人物不露脸）
shots.prompt_en: Before leaving, a hand points in turn at a closed water tap, a switched off power switch, a closed gas valve and a closed window.
shots.narration: 水电气门窗，逐项检查一遍。

shots.section_title: 离开前检查水电气门窗
shots.scene: 阿杰锁好门离开，走廊灯亮
shots.prompt_en: The young male student locks the lab door and leaves down the lit corridor.
shots.narration: 确认无误，再锁门离开。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 书本和负责人图标
shots.prompt_en: An open book icon and a supervisor icon with a check.
shots.narration: 听负责人的话，预习讲义，按规程做。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 禁止饮食和打叉的手
shots.prompt_en: A no eating or drinking sign and a crossed-out hand touching a sample.
shots.narration: 不吃不喝不嬉闹，别人的东西先问。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 两个小人和值守牌
shots.prompt_en: Two person pictograms next to an overnight-run tag and a locked door.
shots.narration: 危险实验不独做，离开检查水电气。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣在守则牌旁挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside the lab rules board.
shots.narration: 下一课，讲安全文化。
